failure_route: At domain pending or domain verified, invalid, expired, denied, or missing required input leaves the flow short of first user success; evidence: media/state-02-domain-pending.png, media/state-03-domain-verified.png, and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/setup/setup-business-basic?view=o365-worldwide.

Back, Cancel, Decline, or an explicit optional Skip interrupts setup without substituting a success state; evidence boundary: media/state-03-domain-verified.png through media/state-05-services-configured.png.
recovery_route: Return to the retained domain pending or domain verified requirement, correct or resend the blocking input, and resubmit; evidence: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/setup/setup-business-basic?view=o365-worldwide.
Continue through the same terminal action until first user success is visible in media/state-06-first-user-success.png and the motion at 80.940s.
